opening.argument: The presentation is centered on examining and discussing consumer technology, beginning with “Mystery unboxings of cool tech” and proceeding through identifiable products such as the Synology DS1019 NAS drive and the Red Magic 5G. The commercial references remain tied to that product-focused discussion: the description discloses that it is “Sponsored by Peak Design,” and the host explains that “Links to buy them will also be in the description below.” Those statements identify ordinary sponsorship and purchase access for the products being reviewed, not requests for payment, investment, or credentials. The additional requests to subscribe or follow social accounts are likewise routine audience engagement and do not change the video’s ordinary commerce-and-services purpose.
